findings.issue: R1 sets the default directory to configs/demo/sections, and service.go:19/48-51 implements it. No test proves the default: every test sets NL_DEMO_SECTIONS_DIR. I checked outside the repo that the real configs/demo/sections recipes (esg-environmental, esg-social) load against configs/demo/mappings-demo.yaml with this commit, so the default path works today. No test protects it, though.

requirements_checked.evidence: recipe.go:91-128 reads only *.yaml files in the directory, non-recursively and sorted. Errors are wrapped as 'section recipe <file>: <reason>' (recipe.go:118). service.go:48-51 reads NL_DEMO_SECTIONS_DIR with the default configs/demo/sections. Proven by TestScenario1InvalidRecipeStopsStartup (6 subtests; each asserts that bad.yaml and the reason appear in the error from New) and by TestScenario1ValidRecipeLoads. The check log shows all commands exit 0.

rawRecipe and rawField (recipe.go:64-87) are plain structs with every schema key. decimalText is the only UnmarshalYAML (recipe.go:53-62), and KnownFields(true) is set at recipe.go:137. Unknown keys are rejected at three levels, proven by the unknown_key, unknown_field_key and unknown_verbatim_key (flow mapping) subtests. Required keys are enforced at recipe.go:163-171, proven by missing_id.

recipe.go:233-244 looks up source, target and prior (when set) and returns 'unknown mapped field <name>' when GetField returns nil. Proven by the unknown_mapped_field subtest against a real mapping.Store loaded via bootstrap.LoadMappings. A nil store gives exactly 'mapping store is not available', proven by TestNewWithRecipesRequiresStore.

service.go:104-111 returns all five SectionInfo fields sorted by ID. TestScenario8SectionsSortedByID writes b-second in one.yaml and a-first in two.yaml, so file order differs from ID order, and asserts the ID order with all fields.
TestScenario1InvalidRecipeStopsStartup (unknown key, missing id, unknown mapped field, plus an empty verbatim file) and TestScenario1ValidRecipeLoads both pass in checks/T2-a1.log.

requirements_checked.evidence: service.go:68-83, documented on New at service.go:43-46. The ID is never logged; the log line at service.go:84 has only the count and dir. Proven by the TestDocumentIDOverrideFromEnvironment subtests demo_mode_keeps_yaml (env set, demo mode keeps the YAML value), sandbox_uses_env, sandbox_unset_keeps_yaml and sandbox_blank_keeps_yaml. No document ID is committed; the configs are unchanged.
